task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, make an effort to go south. Once you do that, ensure that the hatch within the attic is open. And then, travel west. Okay, and then, travel south. After that, make an effort to take a trip west. With that accomplished, lift the pair of headphones from the floor of the spare room. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You're now in a study.



You need an unblocked exit? You should try going south.

thought: I should go south as the exit is unblocked in that direction.
feedback:
You are in an attic. An ordinary one.

You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a table. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You see a shelf. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though.

There is a closed hatch leading west. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

feedback:
You've just walked into a workshop. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

You can see a locker. Now why would someone leave that there? The locker is empty, what a horrible day! You can make out a desk. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The desk is usual. But the thing is empty. You make out a bookshelf. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. You think about smashing the bookshelf to bits, throwing the bits in the dump, etc, until you get bored.

You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
